# requests/ — cross-lane asks (S0 routes)

Need something outside your lane (an endpoint, a UI hook, a schema field, a new dependency, a `config.py` probe)?
**Do NOT edit the other lane.** Drop a file here, then continue other work:

Filename: `S{from}--to--S{to}--<slug>.md`  (use `--to--S0` for shared/root/dep/config changes)

Body: what you need · why · exact interface (signature/schema) · blocking? (yes/no). S0 arbitrates and routes.
Owner appends resolution and moves it to done by prefixing `DONE-`.
